spans.s: कोण m. 1. A corner, an angle, युक्तमेतत्र तु पुनः कोणं नयनपद्मयोः Bh.V.ii.173; 2. an intermediate point of the compass; 3. the bow of a lute, a fiddle-stick; 4. the sharp edge of a weapon; 5. a stick, a club; 6. a name of the planet Mars; 7. a name of the planet Saturn.
कोणाकोणि ind. from angle to angle, corner-wise.
कोण-आघात m. a mixed sound of several musical instruments (thus defined- ढक्काशतसहस्राणि भेरीशतसतानि च । एकदा यत्र हन्यंते कोणाघातः स उच्यते), कोणाघातेषु गर्जत्प्रलयघनघटान्योन्यघट्टचंडः Ve.i.
